"Tell your children of it, and let your children tell their children." What story of God would you pass on?
Joel called the people to a solemn assembly to cry out to the Lord. When should God's people gather to pray?
"Return to me with all your heart... Rend your hearts and not your garments." What does heart-level repentance look like?
"He is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and abounding in steadfast love." Which of these do you need?
"I will restore to you the years that the swarming locust has eaten." What lost years do you need God to restore?
"I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh." How did this come true at Pentecost?
"The Lord is a refuge to his people." How is God your refuge in a shaking world?
"The mountains shall drip sweet wine." What does this picture of God's future blessing show?
